title: Can these counts be compared?
goal: Identify unequal sampling effort and redesign a fairer habitat comparison.
evidence: Student spots area and duration differences and specifies a common repeat method before drawing conclusions.
lesson: Use as a diagnostic task before the next outdoor investigation.
brief: Heading 'Is this a fair comparison?' Ground patterns C. Two equally sized site cards 'Garden: 2 m² • 10 minutes • 20 animals' and 'Paved edge: 1 m² • 5 minutes • 8 animals'. Small habitat illustrations without countable creatures. Prompt 'Check how the samples were collected.' Large blank 'What needs to change?' and blank 'Our plan for a fairer comparison'. Button 'Plan a repeat'. Note 'Counts from one visit.' Do not provide an adjusted density, claim garden richer, or write the answer; no selected winner or badge. Keep graphic habitat interface.
